selection_basis: HB207 gives 12 pieces per brake type and plates97/98 dimension individual segments. Earlier handbook used for the selected standard reconstruction; applicability to every first-100 tank is not independently proven.
alternative_variant: SNL1928 MX108/MX107 long strips: four per brake type, each cut length equals three HB segments plus 6.35 mm. Different copper rivet counts (22/23 per half vs27 HB holes). Do not count both variants together.
interpretation: Printed radii interpreted as inner friction radii. Standard geometric state has lining/drum contact; release and actuation are not modeled poses.
Flat segment length preserved at lining mid-thickness under an estimated inextensible bending interpretation. A 1 mm seam is estimated between the three segments on each half-band.

Nine 9/32 inch countersunk holes per segment. Low-speed explicitly shows70 degrees; apply same included angle to track as an identified assumption. The 1/8 inch note is interpreted as the residual straight drilled stock at the lining outside.

Copper quarter-inch rivets use the later SNL1-1/8 inch under-head stock as a reconstruction estimate for the earlier segmented arrangement. HB hole count governs216 installed rivets; later SNL136 quantity does not apply to this variant.

Steel band stock, axial overhang, terminal margins, longitudinal split clock and connecting shoulder profiles are estimated. Ears/anchors/stops and suspension linkage remain separate pending components.
M339 quantity conflict: HB207 and SNL251 list2, SNL137 lists4. Two long shared pivots vs four short pins must be checked against frame receivers; not silently resolved.
